entities.name: Max (Mordechai) Farbmann
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Max (Mordechai) Farbmann was a Lithuanian Jewish sculptor who achieved prominence in Europe, particularly Vienna, Austria, during the early 20th century. He was responsible for designing the Lithuanian Independence Monument in his native Salakas.
